baseline.authority: Current old H5 under the same account/state/viewport is the final authority. This manifest is a static topology freeze; no runtime gate is claimed.

protocol_inventory.note: No write transaction is authorized or executed in this static implementation pass.

nodes.note: Role outward route. Four top tabs share the same PetModule/OutWardBaseView implementation.
Shared implementation contract.
Prefab/GUID/Bind identity and one shared OutWardBaseView instance per RoleFlow page host.
Type 3/4/5/12 map to wing/fabao/weapon/back with w/a/d/b position keys.
Open requests 16002,16006,16011,16028 and refreshes from authoritative replies.
Training goods come from config_mount_prop(type=1); config_mount_goods is crystal data.
Type switch, hide, reopen and destroy must clear stale model/effect instances and subscriptions.
PetModule prefab has OutWardBaseView Bind nodes including three material and three crystal slots.
Generated binds exist for IllusionBaseView, OutwardLvSystem and PetProptityView but no editable instances are baked into PetModule.prefab.
All four role top tabs are the representative consumer matrix; horse/partner are shared-root regression samples required before final completion.
